text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival...
A special day to express gratitude to the fans who cheer them on day in and day out.

"The day before.
Fusaichi Pandora was making a certain preparation—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehe♡

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Yes, perfect! Wonderful! Looking good!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yay, yaaay♡

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Cute!
The fans are gonna be overjoyed with this!

...Yes, the "Special Umamusume Present Lottery"
held during the Fan Appreciation Festival—
We ended up joining an event where you could win gifts elaborately put together by various Umamusume through a lottery raffle!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew!
Photo shoots really are so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
My bromide photo turned out super cute,
so whoever gets it is gonna love it, I'm sure!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I wonder what everyone else chose?
Now I'm really curious!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Let me go ask real quick~☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, what do we have here?
Ku-chan senpai gave me a handmade patch, and Heart-chan gave me a souvenir from Americaâ

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Kawakami-senpai is... hand-drawing a coloring book!? Why!? Wait, that's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh...
Everyone's really pumped up, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: N... nah, I was just wondering if it's really okay for me to be on a bromide card.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, you're the one who went out of your way to come to Fan Fest and even won the lottery... right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it? Like everyone else...
don't you think we need a bit more of a 'rare' feel? A special vibe?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What could it be?! Something that feels like me,
and that I can get ready right away...—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, what about candid shots!?
Like treasure photos sleeping in your camera roll☆

And so,
I suddenly had to dig through my photo folders. However—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aww, this one's cut off, this one's too plain.
This one's blurry~,
and this one... Heart-chan's way too close, so that's a no-go, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Surprisingly, there isn't a single one that's just right~~!
Following her lead, I browse through my photo album. Looking for a better shot, a nicer situation—
There was photo data from the go-kart ride at the nature park, taken when we went there together before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You found it?!
Lemme see, lemme see?!
"It's a refreshing shot of her having fun with a natural smile. I'm partially in the frame too, but it should be easily croppable without looking awkward—or so I thought."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ......Ehh, this one?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, come on...
It's a precious memory for all of us."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
This is a photo from our very first day,
when we were like, "Let's conquer the Twinkle Series!", right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So... you can't have this.
Because this one's just for the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Jeez, memories are obviously priceless! You better treasure them, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Wait! Hold on! I just had a great idea!!
—And so, the day of the Fan Appreciation Festival arrived.

text_block_list.name: Fan Appreciation Festival Staff
text_block_list.text:
And next up is Fusaichi Pandora!
The gift everyone's curious about is—

text_block_list.name: Fan Appreciation Festival Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da!
It's a "Take a photo together right now coupon"~!
(Ooooohh!?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha♡
Let's win that lottery~ and make some precious memories, okay?

Thanks to Fusaichi Pandora's splendid hype,
the raffle event was enveloped in tremendous excitement—

text_block_list.name: Fan Appreciation Festival Staff
text_block_list.text:
And now,
the winner of the raffle for a "Ticket to take a photo together right now" is—Ticket Number 1112!

text_block_list.name: Number 1112
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAGH!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Come on, come over here♡
Let's take a two-shot, a two-shot♡
It turned out to be a thoroughly enjoyable Fan Appreciation Day!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on that camera, okay?!
Here we goooo!

text_block_list.name: Number 1112
text_block_list.text:
Ah! C-Could that person over there be...
Trainer-san!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, but—

text_block_list.name: Number 1112
text_block_list.text:
Uwoh! U-Um! I'm so sorry if this is presumptuous
of me to ask, but if it's possible,
would you join in too, Trainer――!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, you support all of us? Aha♡
Alrighty then♡ Hey, Trainer, take a picture with us!

And so, the photo of two suddenly
became a photo of three—
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Number 1112
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaaaah
Thank you so muchhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
The pleasure is all mine♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That was so fun!
Like... we just made another special memory together, huh? ♡
It turned out to be a truly special Fan Appreciation Day!
